setup.command: apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1; cd possible-solution/client && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../server && pip3 install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt

run.command: cd possible-solution/server && (python3 app.py > /tmp/flights-api.log 2>&1 &) && cd ../client && npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
